# App Blueprints: AI Documentation Index (llms.txt)

> Title: App Blueprints
> Author: Belal Waheed
> Description: Production full-stack starter templates, snippets, and AI agent knowledge engine.
> Repository: https://github.com/belal-waheed/app-blueprints
> Primary Stacks: Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Hono TS, Dexie.js, Resend, Playwright.

## Core Documentation & AI Protocols
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Autonomous AI agent operating guidelines, non-negotiable constraints, prompt recipes, and platform troubleshooting matrix.
- [PATTERN_TEMPLATE.md](PATTERN_TEMPLATE.md): Standardized blueprint schema for contributing new patterns.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Complete unrolled context file for single-shot LLM injection.

## Domain-Driven Snippets
- [Auth: PBKDF2 Web Crypto](snippets/auth/pbkdf2-crypto.ts): Web Crypto API password hashing and verification.
- [Auth: 6-Box Segmented OtpInput](snippets/auth/otp-input-component.tsx): Auto-advancing, paste-friendly OTP component with Framer Motion support.
- [Auth: Password Strength Meter](snippets/auth/password-strength.ts): 3-tier password complexity evaluation.
- [Email: RFC 5322 MIME Builder](snippets/email/raw-mime-builder.ts): Multipart/alternative email envelope constructor for Cloudflare send_email.
- [Email: Cloudflare send_email Dispatcher](snippets/email/cloudflare-send-email.ts): EmailMessage dispatcher with Resend fallback.
- [Sync: LWW Conflict Resolution](snippets/sync-offline/lww-merge-algorithm.ts): Last-Write-Wins deterministic record merging.
- [Sync: Tombstone Deletions](snippets/sync-offline/tombstone-delete-handler.ts): Soft-delete persistence for multi-device sync.
- [Sync: BroadcastChannel Reactivity](snippets/sync-offline/broadcast-channel-sync.ts): Cross-tab live synchronization.
- [Scraping: Multi-Tier Metadata Extractor](snippets/scraping/multi-tier-metadata.ts): Unified extraction engine with SSRF defense, tracking sanitizer, media adapters (YouTube, TikTok, X, GitHub, Wikipedia, Reddit, Spotify), JSON-LD parser, and @extractus/article-extractor reader mode & reading time calculation.
- [Scraping: Smart Domain Auto-Grouper](snippets/scraping/smart-auto-grouper.ts): Zero-dependency domain auto-grouper mapping URLs into smart groups (YT, Insta, X) with custom vault scoping.
- [Scraping: Anti-Bot Cloud Bypass](snippets/scraping/microlink-anti-bot-cloud.ts): Headless cloud renderer for 403-protected pages.
- [UI: Back-Button Modal Trapper](snippets/ui-navigation/modal-back-navigation.ts): Android back gesture and popstate navigation handler.
- [Testing: Microsoft Edge Playwright Harness](snippets/testing-automation/edge-playwright-harness.ts): Headless Edge browser automation config.

## Production Starter Templates
- [Template: 3-Stage Auth Recovery Wizard](templates/auth-recovery-wizard/README.md): Standalone password recovery app.
- [Template: Offline-First PWA Multi-Device Sync](templates/pwa-offline-sync/README.md): Dexie.js + Cloudflare D1 multi-device sync app.
- [Template: Universal Metadata Scraper API](templates/universal-media-scraper/README.md): Fast-path metadata & cover image API.
- [Template: Edge Browser Automation](templates/edge-browser-automation/README.md): Playwright test suite for Edge.
